title: Bifurcation of periodic and antiperiodic solutions in non-autonomous potential-type delay systems
summary: As a continuation of our previous work, where bifurcations of periodic and antiperiodic orbits near an equilibrium were studied for autonomous differential delay systems with one or two delays, this paper investigates bifurcations of periodic and antiperiodic solutions for five classes of non-autonomous potential delay differential systems with multiple delays.
